publication.title: Result publication
publication.confirmPublish: Publish the assessments to the student?
publication.publishDescription: The student will see all completed assessments of this final version, criterion scores and feedback. Published assessments will be locked for editing.
publication.withdrawDescription: The student will no longer see this version’s assessments. Scores and comments will be preserved so they can be corrected and published again.
publication.studentPrivate: Results for this version have not been published yet.
publication.locked: These results are published. The teacher must withdraw them before they can be edited.

errors.notFinal: Only final version results can be published.
errors.noReviews: Assign and complete an assessment first.
errors.incomplete: All assigned assessments must be completed before publication.
errors.forbidden: You cannot publish results for this work.
errors.notFound: This work is no longer available.
errors.serverError: The publication change could not be saved.

publicResults.title: Public results
publicResults.empty: No classes have been shared yet.
publicResults.subject: Subject and year
publicResults.legend: Task points are the mean of all reviews. A dash means no published result and counts as 0. An asterisk marks a provisional grade.
publicResults.explanation: Results are not listed publicly. Anyone with the link can view school IDs, published points and comments, work previews and grades. Students without a school ID are omitted. You can revoke the link at any time.
publicResults.confirm: Create a link to share this class’s results and work previews?
publicResults.unlisted: Results are available only through a sharing link from your teacher. Open the link you received for your class.
publicResults.rotateConfirm: Revoke the current link and generate a new one? The old link will stop working.
publicResults.sharedNotice: Shared results · students are identified by school ID
publicResults.previewHint: Open points to view the work and comments.

schoolGrading.title: School grading scale
schoolGrading.description: Applies to public results in every class of this school. Changes immediately recalculate final grades; stored points stay the same.
schoolGrading.error: Thresholds must be between 0 and 100 and strictly descending.

teacherResults.title: Results and grades
teacherResults.name: Student
teacherResults.points: Points (+ or −, up to 2 decimal places)
teacherResults.visibilityHelp: Adjustments always affect totals and grades. This option shows the entry and reason only to the signed-in student in their own results. Reasons are never included in the shared link.
teacherResults.invalidPoints: Enter a non-zero amount with up to two decimal places (maximum ±10,000).
teacherResults.applyHelp: The adjustment immediately affects results based on published reviews too. Original task evaluations stay the same.
teacherResults.explanation: Latest final versions are shown with two decimal places. Unpublished results are marked. The margin shows the boundary that still retains the current grade; falling below it results in a worse grade.
teacherResults.studentExplanation: Your published results and final grade including point adjustments.
teacherResults.revokeConfirm: Revoke this adjustment? The entry stays in history but its points stop counting.

consultation.title: Consultation for version {version}
consultation.description: A discussion between the student and teacher about this WIP version. Messages stay with the original version and are separate from grading and public results.
consultation.empty: No messages yet. Ask a question or share feedback.
consultation.label: Consultation message
consultation.loadError: Could not load the consultation. Try refreshing the discussion.
consultation.saveError: Could not send the message. Your text has been preserved.
consultation.rateLimit: Too many messages. Try again shortly.

modelPreview.error: Could not load the 3D preview. Check WebGL support and use a self-contained GLB 2.0 without compression.
modelPreview.controls: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. Arrow keys control the view when focused.

studentTransfer.title: Move students to another group
studentTransfer.description: Students will be removed only from the selected source group and added to the destination group. Other memberships are preserved. Work, evaluations and adjustments remain with the original assignments and subjects; they are not transferred to assignments in the new group.
studentTransfer.existing: Students who already belong to the destination group will not get duplicate memberships.
studentTransfer.empty: There are no other groups in the same school that you can manage.

errors.forbidden: You must have permission to manage both groups.
errors.differentSchool: Students can only move between groups in the same school.
errors.membershipChanged: A student’s membership or status has changed. Refresh the list; nobody was moved.
errors.invalidRequest: Select 1–200 different students and a destination group.
errors.transferFailed: The move failed. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load groups. Close the dialog and try again.

studentTransfer.noSource: The selected students do not share a source group. Filter by one class or change your selection.
